requirements.text: Each Business Day, as of the close of regular trading on the NYSE (ordinarily 4:00 p.m. ET), value every FLEX Option position in the portfolio and recompute the Fund's NAV; if the NYSE closes early, value as of that earlier time.
requirements.source: USBFS ... calculates the Fund's NAV at the close of regular trading (ordinarily 4:00 p.m. E.S.T.) every day the New York Stock Exchange is open.

requirements.text: Value each FLEX Option at the exchange's model-based price at the official close of that exchange's trading day, applying the same model price to both purchased and written positions.
requirements.source: FLEX Options listed on an exchange will typically be valued at a model-based price provided by the exchange at the official close of that exchange's trading day.

requirements.text: When a FLEX Option has a same-day market trading (sale) price, use that same-day trade price for that option's value instead of the exchange model-based price.
requirements.source: However, when the Fund's option has a same-day market trading price, this same-day market trading price will be used for FLEX Option values instead of the exchange's model-based price.

requirements.text: If the exchange cannot provide a model price, use the backup third-party pricing provider's model price; if neither vendor is available, value per the Valuation Designee/Valuation Procedures.
requirements.source: If the exchange on which the option is traded is unable to provide a model price, model-based FLEX Options prices will additionally be provided by a backup third-party pricing provider. If either pricing vendor is not available to provide a model price for that day, the value of a FLEX option will be determined by Innovator as Valuation Designee in accordance with the Valuation Procedures.

requirements.text: When the same FLEX Option appears the same trading day in both an all-cash basket and an in-kind basket, default to the trade price for both instances rather than the model price for the in-kind transaction.
requirements.source: In instances where in the same trading day, a particular FLEX Option is represented in an all-cash basket ... as well as in an in-kind basket ... for valuation purposes that trading day the Fund will default to use the trade price for both instances, rather than the model price otherwise available for the in-kind transaction.

requirements.text: Record each purchased option at the premium paid as an asset, and each written option at the premium received as a liability; mark each to its current value daily, with the day-over-day change recorded as unrealized gain/(loss).
requirements.source: When the Funds purchase an option, an amount equal to the premium paid ... are recorded as an investment and is subsequently adjusted to the current value ... When the Funds write an option, an amount equal to the premium received ... are recorded as a liability and is subsequently adjusted to the current value of the option written.

requirements.text: Each day accrue the unitary management fee at 0.79% of average daily net assets (annual rate / 365 per calendar day, including each day over a weekend/holiday) and carry it as a liability until paid.
requirements.source: the Fund has agreed to pay an annual unitary management fee to Innovator in an amount equal to 0.79% of its average daily net assets.

requirements.text: Each day accrue interest income on the Money Market Deposit Account at its variable daily rate (annual rate / 365 per calendar day), including days over a weekend/holiday, and include accrued interest in net assets.
requirements.source: The MMDA ... will bear interest at a variable rate ... The NAV ... includes any interest or dividends accrued but not yet collected.

requirements.text: Compute NAV per share by taking total assets (including accrued interest/dividends) less all liabilities (including written-option values and accrued fees), dividing by shares outstanding, and rounding to the nearest cent.
requirements.source: the market price of the Fund's total assets, including any interest or dividends accrued but not yet collected, less all liabilities, and dividing such amount by the total number of Shares outstanding. The result, rounded to the nearest cent is the NAV per Share.

requirements.text: Record investment transactions (option opens, closing buys/sells, exercises/expirations) on trade date, determining realized gain/(loss) on an identified-cost basis.
requirements.source: Investment transactions are recorded on the trade date. The Trust determines the gain or loss realized from investment transactions on the basis of identified cost.

requirements.text: On a closing purchase of a written option, realize a gain equal to premium received less amount paid including brokerage commissions; on a sale (closing) of a purchased option, realize gain/(loss) equal to proceeds less identified cost.
requirements.source: The difference between the premium and the amount paid on effecting a closing purchase transaction, including brokerage commissions, is also treated as a realized gain, or if the premium is less than the amount paid ... as a realized loss.

requirements.text: At the conclusion of the Outcome Period, cash-settle all FLEX Options: each pays/receives the difference between the reference closing price return and the strike times the multiplier (100 shares/contract, floored at zero per option), realize the resulting gain/(loss), and record proceeds as cash.
requirements.source: Upon conclusion of the Outcome Period, the Fund will receive the cash value of all the FLEX Options it held ... The amount of cash is equal to the difference between the closing price of the Reference Asset's price return and the exercise price of the option contract times a specified multiple (multiplier). Option contracts that expire unexercised have no value.

requirements.text: On a cash creation/redemption, price shares at NAV per Creation Unit (NAV/share x shares/CU); the purchaser pays NAV plus the transaction fee and any costs, and the redeemer receives NAV minus the transaction fee and any costs.
requirements.source: The price for each Creation Unit will equal the daily NAV per share of a Fund times the number of shares in a Creation Unit, plus the fees ... The price received for each Creation Unit will equal the daily NAV per share ... minus the fees described above.

requirements.text: On an in-kind redemption, deliver the designated basket of option contracts, settle the Cash Redemption Amount equal to the difference between the Creation Unit NAV and the aggregate market value of the delivered instruments, less the transaction fee; realize gain/(loss) in-kind on options delivered using identified cost.
requirements.source: the redemption proceeds ... consist of the Deposit Instruments ... plus or minus cash in an amount equal to the difference between the net asset value ... and the aggregate market value of the Deposit Instruments (the Cash Redemption Amount), less the applicable Redemption Transaction Fee.

requirements.text: A transaction fee applies once per creation/redemption order regardless of the number of units in the order.
requirements.source: A transaction fee is applicable to each transaction regardless of the number of units purchased or sold in the transaction.

requirements.text: On a corporate action in the reference ETF (e.g., a stock split), apply the OCC contract adjustment so that strike and contract counts are adjusted together; value the position on the adjusted contracts and adjusted model price, ensuring economic value is unchanged.
requirements.source: FLEX Options ... are customized option contracts ... guaranteed for settlement by the Options Clearing Corporation (OCC).

requirements.text: Because the Fund holds FLEX Options referencing the ETF on a price-return basis, do not accrue reference-ETF dividends as Fund income; only the daily option model prices reflect the ex-dividend; reflect value change solely through option marks.
requirements.source: the Cap and Buffer will be provided on a price return basis ... and the Fund will not receive the benefit of any dividends.
